title: Macro Event Edge Pipeline Input
description: Pulls upcoming high-impact economic events, attaches trader sentiment and prediction-market odds, scores an edge 0 to 100, and tiers each event.

range.title: Calendar range
range.description: Which window of the economic calendar to pull. this_month gives the fullest catalyst set.

impactLevels.title: Impact levels
impactLevels.description: Which event impact levels to score. high alone is the cleanest catalyst set.

currencies.title: Currencies (optional)
currencies.description: Limit to events for these currencies, e.g. ["USD", "EUR"]. Empty pulls all.

maxEventsTotal.title: Max events to score
maxEventsTotal.description: Cap on events scored, soonest first.

includeTradingView.title: Include trader sentiment
includeTradingView.description: Attach TradingView ideas for the symbols tied to each event's currency.

includePolymarket.title: Include prediction markets
includePolymarket.description: Attach Polymarket odds for the macro topics present in the calendar.

maxIdeasPerSymbol.title: Max trader ideas per symbol
maxIdeasPerSymbol.description: How many TradingView ideas to pull per affected symbol. Higher reads sentiment better but raises the child cost.

minScore.title: Minimum edge score
minScore.description: Drop and never charge events scoring below this 0 to 100 threshold. 0 keeps every qualifying event.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy passed through to the child actors. Residential is recommended for the calendar and TradingView.
